reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual second-round review of external-02 against the exact native source, enlarged source page 13 and targeted source panel, complete unchanged full native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution face/cap and returned-note crops, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference; earlier review files were left unchanged

remaining_reasons: The source has a three-quarter head pose facing viewer right with a rightward gaze. The return reverses this toward viewer left, changing the nose/mouth direction and eye asymmetry. Restore the source viewer-right pose and gaze.
The returned note adds a separate third lower-left gray dash below its two main rows. Remove that added third mark and retain only the source's original compact two-row mark footprint.

The source's small dark right-edge tab is replaced by a much larger dark upper-right folded/clip-like corner. Restore the original small tab at its source position and scale rather than the oversized upper-right corner treatment.
entries.positive_observation: The cap crown and glossy visor remain inside the original dark frame silhouette; no cap/frame crossing or changed frame outline is visible. The dark olive cap retains two gold front insignia elements and gold braid/piping. Dark brows remain, with covered hair and no glasses, moustache or beard. The dark olive tunic retains the red standing collar and gold-embroidered red tabs without a visible tie. The rounded lower head meets a short broad collar. The opaque dark olive-charcoal backplate and complete frame remain, and full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring. The reversed pose, third note dash and oversized corner/tab treatment are the separate rejection reasons above.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine motifs inside the cap/collar insignia and note glyphs are unreadable at source scale. No additional rejection is based on those tiny details; pose direction, the separate third dash and the visibly enlarged upper-right corner treatment are clear in native views.
